name: manual_641cfe
claim: A process-lost run has no terminal receipt because only the in-process runner writes one; who records the terminal after a takeover is an explicit design decision, so recovery must state outcome unknown rather than infer one.

decisions.notes: SIGKILL through the real runner left held attempts unknown and no terminal; recovery_accounting had no production caller.

rationale: SIGKILL through the real runner left held attempts unknown and no terminal; recovery_accounting had no production caller.
